zh: 海上起了大雾。九点整，船长下令抛锚，等天亮再走。
{setting}停在航道中央：谁也上不来，谁也下不去。
最后一次确认它还在桌上，是 {seen}。
你是搭这班船回家的退休侦探，刚在铺位上躺下，有人敲响了舱门。
所有人都在观景厅等你。
en: Fog on the water. At nine o'clock the captain of {setting} dropped anchor to wait for daylight. The ferry sits in the middle of the channel: nobody gets on, nobody gets off.
At {found}, {client} returned to the stateroom and found the {item} gone. It was last confirmed on the table during {seen}.
You are a retired detective taking this boat home. You have just lain down in your berth when someone knocks. Everyone is waiting in the lounge.

zh: 驾驶室 ── 楼梯间 ── 观景厅 ── 酒吧
贵宾舱 ── 客舱区 ── 餐室 ── 厨房

persona.zh: 说话利落，不喜欢被打断，对船上的事一清二楚。
persona.en: Brisk, hates being interrupted, knows every rivet of the boat.

persona.zh: 沉稳，话少，爱用海上的说法打比方。
persona.en: Steady and sparing with words, likes a nautical turn of phrase.

motive.zh: 船东要卖掉这条航线，退休金悬在半空。
motive.en: The owner is selling the route, and the pension is up in the air.

persona.zh: 周到得体，记得每位乘客的舱号。
persona.en: Tactful and attentive, remembers every passenger's cabin.

motive.zh: 替家里还债，已经预支了三个月工资。
motive.en: Paying off a family debt, already three months' wages in advance.

persona.zh: 嗓门大，手上总有机油，脾气直。
persona.en: Loud, oil on the hands, says what comes to mind.

motive.zh: 修船的零件钱被拖了半年没结。
motive.en: Half a year of parts money still unpaid by the owner.

persona.zh: 爱搭话，什么客人都聊得来。
persona.en: Chatty, gets on with any customer.

motive.zh: 想开自己的小店，本钱还差一大截。
motive.en: Saving for a place of their own, and still far short.

persona.zh: 问的比答的多，随手记笔记。
persona.en: Asks more than answers, always jotting something down.

motive.zh: 在查这家船运公司的旧账，正缺一条独家。
motive.en: Digging into the company's old books and short of an exclusive.

persona.zh: 冷静，说话有条理，不爱闲聊。
persona.en: Calm and orderly in speech, no taste for chit-chat.

motive.zh: 诊所欠着房租，已经收到第二封催款信。
motive.en: The clinic is behind on rent, and the second demand letter has arrived.

persona.zh: 闷头干活，开口就是抱怨食材。
persona.en: Keeps head down, opens mouth only to complain about supplies.

motive.zh: 船东当众说过要换掉这条船的伙食承包。
motive.en: The owner said in front of everyone that the galley contract would go.

persona.zh: 客气圆滑，话里总留三分。
persona.en: Smooth and courteous, never says quite everything.

motive.zh: 曾替买家出价被拒，一笔佣金泡了汤。
motive.en: A buyer's offer was refused, and a fat commission went with it.

text.zh: {client}手机里的照片：{time}，{item}还好好地放在贵宾舱的桌上。
text.en: A photo on {client}'s phone shows the {item} on the stateroom table at {time}.

text.zh: 驾驶室的值班日志写着：{time}，{person}上来过。
text.en: The wheelhouse duty log reads: {time}, {person} came up.

text.zh: 楼梯间的监控截图：{time}，{person}正在这里。
text.en: A stairwell camera still shows {person} there at {time}.

text.zh: 观景厅的借书登记上有{person}的名字，时间是 {time}。
text.en: The lounge book-loan sheet lists {person} at {time}.

text.zh: 酒吧的账单上有{person}的签名，时间是 {time}。
text.en: A bar tab bears {person}'s signature, timed {time}.

text.zh: 客舱区门禁记录显示，{person}的房卡在 {time} 刷开了舱门。
text.en: The cabin door log shows {person}'s key card at {time}.

text.zh: 餐室点单本上写着：{time}，{person}要了一碗姜汤。
text.en: The mess-room order pad reads: {time}, {person} asked for ginger soup.

text.zh: 厨房白板上有{person}留的字条，落款时间 {time}。
text.en: A note on the galley whiteboard, signed by {person}, is timed {time}.

text.zh: {person}的手机里有一张 {time} 在{location}拍的照片。
text.en: {person}'s phone holds a photo taken in the {location} at {time}.
